title: About Me
subtitle: How I lead, and what I care about

content.paragraph1: I studied at Tallinn University of Technology and have been building software ever since: first as a developer, then as a team lead at Audatex (Solera), and now as Engineering Manager at Interprefy. Along the way I've worked on financial messaging, telecom, insurance and government systems for clients across Europe.
content.paragraph2: I currently lead three teams, about 15 developers and QA engineers, working on a real-time AI translation platform. Over the past few years the platform has moved from relying on human interpreters to an AI stack that now handles the majority of customer translation, and the way we build it has changed just as much.
content.paragraph3: What I care about most is how the team works together. I want people to feel safe questioning a decision, including mine, and I'd rather remove a bottleneck than add a rule. Good process should make work easier: when we unified how our three teams release, each team got more control over its own deployments, and we started fixing technical debt before it turned into incidents.
